method.source: Independent minidom text-node projection from sixteen SHA-pinned XML files, all published inputs. Every source-to-record slice and exact paragraph restoration is checked, including the markerless IV.276 paragraph and the pre-milestone VIII.255 continuation with their explicit paragraph separators. The Book I-X corpora, extraction reports and search bundles remain byte-for-byte identical to the accepted prior release. Book XI keeps its actual physical order and does not invent numerical-order phrase adjacency. Prefix continuations in XII.147, XII.226 and XIV.237 retain their source IDs, exact offsets and paragraph joins; XIII and XIV anchors and XV chapter milestones contribute no extra searchable text or phrase barrier. Book IX restored text is published; its seven inline footnotes and restored headings are excluded. Book X transparent bold formatting preserves running text without inventing editorial additions.
method.tokens: Every indexed Unicode word and original UTF-16 offset independently scanned in Python and JavaScript and compared with each serialized book index.
method.queries: All literal vocabulary per book, one exact phrase per interval, every neighboring citation seam, all fourteen book boundaries, bounded wildcard and explicit Boolean fixtures. Expected ASTs and sequential phrase scans do not import production parsing/tokenization. Published Book IX footnote exclusions, phrases across excluded notes, restored English intervals and Book X transparent formatting have focused checks. Combined selections preserve distinct same-numbered sections and keep phrases and Boolean conditions inside their own book.
method.language: English-only and mixed English/Latin collection requests verify Latin-only spelling equivalence and separate Boolean scopes.
method.exports: Concordance geometry, original context, reader parameters, source slices, source fingerprints, CSV decoding, negative-only units and zero-result summaries.
